raw_source.title: We are Clave - Remote First Company
raw_source.body:
We are Clave and seeking senior blockchain & web3 developers who can be resemble for building our blockchain platform. You’ll work with product and engineering teams to turn complex requirements into reliable smart contracts and user-facing applications.

- Role: Senior Blockchain Developer
- Compensation Range: 200-300k
- Location: 5 Beaufort Court, Admirals Way, London, United Kingdom, E14 9XL - remote
- Employment type: [Full-time / Contract]

What you’ll do

- Design, develop, test, and maintain smart contracts and blockchain services.
- Build and integrate Web3 features with frontend and backend systems.
- Review code and contribute to security audits and best practices.
- Investigate performance, reliability, and on-chain integration issues.
- Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams.
- Mentor developers and help shape technical architecture.

What we’re looking for

- 7+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial blockchain experience.
- Strong experience with Solidity and the EVM ecosystem.
- Familiarity with smart-contract testing, deployment, and security practices.
- Experience integrating wallets, web3 libraries, and blockchain APIs.
- Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript; backend experience is a plus.
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills.

Nice to have

- Experience with Layer 2 networks, DeFi, token standards, or cross-chain systems.
- Familiarity with Foundry, Hardhat, or similar development tools.
- Experience operating production blockchain applications

You can check company information here:

- Site: https://getclave.com
- X / Twitter: https://x.com/getclave
- Linkedin: https://www.linkedin.com/company/getclave/
- Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@getclave
- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/getclave

Please dm me and don't hesitate to ask about this role.
Telegram: @markmcdonaugh
